notes: Source customers_in is DATABASETYPE='Flat File': comma-delimited, QUOTE_CHARACTER DOUBLE, SKIPROWS 1 (a header line). The session's File Reader names the file ($PMSourceFileDir\crm\customers_20260929.csv); on AIDP the path is a job parameter, which the harness sets to a local file.
"Smith, John" is one field: the comma is inside double quotes.
An empty field is NULL: customer 2's CREDIT, customer 3's CITY, customer 4's SIGNUP_DT.
The file is text; ports are typed: CREDIT number(12,2), SIGNUP_DT datetime in the default MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS format.
TIER: CREDIT >= 1000 -> GOLD; NULL CREDIT -> NONE (IIF(NULL >= 1000) is not true, then ISNULL); else STD. TO_CHAR(NULL date, 'YYYY') is NULL.

Flat-file target customers_out: pipe-delimited, QUOTE_CHARACTER NONE, 'Header Options' = Output Field Names (a header line), not appended. number(12,2) is written with two decimals, a date/time as MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS, NULL as an empty field.
